todo_line: - [ ] 001 Implement and test the actor-bearing custom-group removal use case at the Club boundary, including custom-group/actor/target validation, self/last-member removal, idempotency, and reuse of `GroupMemberRemoved` without club/role removal.
outcome: Verify and, only if focused evidence exposes a gap, complete the existing task-001 candidate so it is ready for review as one tested Club-boundary custom-group removal use case; do not absorb follow cleanup or the iteration-wide dev check.
scope: Inspect the current candidate in Memba.Membership, RemoveCustomGroupMember, Memba.Membership.Router, and Memba.Membership.Club; preserve its dedicated actor-bearing public path and the separate trusted actor-free RemoveGroupMember path.

Confirm from focused tests that the Club aggregate authorizes a current custom-group member or active club.manage_members holder, including an outside admin, and rejects ordinary/inactive outsiders, system groups, invalid identities, and mismatched target identities.
Confirm self-removal, final-member removal, and exact event-free retries, including the explicit self-retry case after the actor has left the group.

Confirm a real transition emits only the existing GroupMemberRemoved fact, updates the group-membership projection, and preserves active club membership, Admin role assignment, and club management permission.
If any focused check fails, make only the smallest task-001 implementation or test correction needed and rerun the focused checks; otherwise return the unchanged candidate as ready for review.
scope_exclusions: Do not change the ClearRemovedGroupMemberFollows policy, Messaging follow semantics, or stale cleanup/remove-re-add ordering; pending tasks 004-008 own that cross-context outcome.
Do not change conversation/query authorization, queued email delivery handoff, or open LiveView refresh behavior; pending tasks 009-011 own those boundaries.
Do not add Leave/Remove controls, confirmations, member-row changes, or post-removal UI surfaces.
Do not edit the iteration 064 acceptance feature files or remove their todo runner tags in this packet.
Do not change Everyone/Admin membership policy, club-member removal, club role removal, group archiving/deletion, or club invitation behavior.

references.facts: Implementation Plan 1 requires the actor-bearing removal use case at the Club boundary; acceptance permits group members and active outside admins, self and last-member removal, rejects system groups/ordinary outsiders, and preserves club membership and roles.

Club is the authoritative consistency boundary for active club membership and Admin continuity. The approved iteration plan separately requires this custom-group removal decision to use the same established Club-owned authorization as iteration 063; do not characterize the ADR as a general mandate to move all arbitrary-group ownership into Club.
Membership owns group membership state. This packet stays within Membership and leaves cross-context follow cleanup to the later policy obligation.
Accepted iteration 063 command shape carries club, group, target membership/person, and authenticated actor identities and routes by club_id.

The current candidate exposes remove_custom_group_member/1 and /2 and translates all five required identities into RemoveCustomGroupMember. remove_member/2 remains club departure and must not be reused for custom-group removal.

The current candidate's RemoveCustomGroupMember execute path validates typed identities and a custom group, authorizes from current aggregate state, validates the exact target, supports event-free retries, and delegates the real transition to GroupMemberRemoved. Trusted RemoveGroupMember remains a separate actor-free internal path.
This actor-free command explicitly documents itself as trusted internal policy/backfill/fixture infrastructure, not the public custom-group removal path.
The existing durable fact contains club, group, membership, and person identities and does not carry actor identity; reuse it without changing club or role state.

Accepted dispatch-level examples cover member and outside-admin actors, current/forged identities, system-group guards, idempotency, projections, and unchanged invitations/roles; removal should receive analogous focused coverage.
The AddCustomGroupMember authorization describe block and trusted RemoveGroupMember tests establish aggregate test conventions and the accepted current-state behavior to extend without weakening.
This test protects actor-bearing versus trusted actor-free command shapes and confirms GroupMemberRemoved remains actor-free and JSON encodable.
The current candidate asserts remove_custom_group_member/1 and /2 are public while the trusted remove_group_member operation remains absent from the public API.
Follow the project Elixir module and focused-test conventions; avoid timing sleeps and start test processes with start_supervised!/1 where applicable.

constraints: Do not authorize from projections or web-supplied role claims; the Club aggregate's current event-sourced state owns the final actor, target, and group decision.
Do not broaden or replace the trusted RemoveGroupMember path used by system-group policies and replay/setup code.
Do not add actor_person_id to GroupMemberRemoved; actor identity belongs on the command, while the existing event remains the reusable membership fact.

A group member may remove any active member including themselves; an active club manager may remove any member while outside the group; an ordinary active club member outside the group is unauthorized.
System groups are rejected through the public custom-group use case. Existing Everyone/Admin rules and last-Admin protection remain governed by their current club/role operations.
No custom-group member floor exists: the last member may leave and the group/history/identity remain unchanged.
Keep a successful exact retry event-free and avoid projection races when deciding whether a transition is new.

Do not run dev check, dev check --quick, dev ci, browser acceptance, or another unscoped full-suite command in this ordinary task packet; the deterministic final gate and explicit task 017 own iteration-wide validation.
completion_evidence_required: List every changed path, or explicitly report that the carried candidate required no changes; identify the verified public API, actor-bearing command, Club decision, and focused tests.

Report passing evidence for member removal, outside-admin removal without joining, ordinary outsider rejection, self-removal, last-member removal, exact retry idempotency, target/actor/group identity rejection, and system-group rejection.
Show that GroupMemberRemoved is the only domain event for a real custom-group removal and that the target's club membership and Admin role/management permission survive.
Report both exact focused test commands, exit statuses, and test/failure counts. Do not claim or require iteration-wide dev check evidence from this packet.
Return ready_for_review only when task 001 has no unresolved implementation or focused-test gap; otherwise return a concrete replan or human-blocked result.
